family_summary: Checks one-lattice species/endmember coverage, ordered polynomial identities, property ownership and magnetic variant consistency.

rules.purpose: The single sublattice must list exactly as many tokens as there are declared species.
Magnetic M, TCL and BML properties require an IHJ magnetic structure. An all-zero magnetic structure is valid.
Each declared species must occur exactly once in the single sublattice token list.
Each polynomial species must have exactly one endmember.
Polynomial species require a nonempty composition, including any preprocessed stoichiometric scaling.
A polynomial endmember name must match its constituent species name literally.
Polynomial endmembers accept G, M and the existing physical-property types, not interaction or MQM properties.
A polynomial-phase interaction must contain one site with two to four constituents.
Each polynomial-phase interaction requires at least one property, and accepts only PolynomialL, TCL or BML.
Interaction constituents must be distinct; their listed order defines the exponent positions.
PolynomialL is valid only on an interaction of a SingleSublatticePolynomialPhaseType phase.
Polynomial exponents must match constituent arity: i,j; i,j,k; or i,j,k,l. Explicit zero powers are valid.
A polynomial coefficient expression must contain text; an explicit zero is valid.
Ordered constituent/exponent identities must be unique across all PolynomialL properties and interactions in a phase, regardless of interaction names or coefficient text.
Polynomial interpolation requires one site containing exactly one i, j and k locator, using the site attribute.
